context: A barista and a uni student talk coffee origins and trends
purpose: Teach: 仮想/カルチャー/娯楽/野生/広域/頻度/産地/石炭

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最近、コーヒーの産地によって味が全然違うって知って、ちょっとハマってるんです。
lines.en: Lately I learned coffee tastes totally different depending on the origin, and I'm kind of into it.
lines.style: Curious uni student speaking politely with casual enthusiasm to the barista.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいですね。最近は産地直送の豆を扱うお店も増えて、選ぶ楽しさが広がってますよ。
lines.en: That's great. More shops are handling beans shipped direct from the origin, so the fun of choosing has expanded.
lines.style: Warm professional barista sharing industry knowledge with friendly approachable tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: コーヒーって、もう一つのカルチャーって感じですよね。奥が深そうで楽しいです。
lines.en: Coffee really feels like its own culture, doesn't it. It seems deep, and that's fun.
lines.style: Observant young man making cultural observation with casual conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ええ。最近は仮想空間で世界中のロースターと交流できる場もあって、面白い時代ですよね。
lines.en: Yes. Lately there are even places in virtual spaces where you can connect with roasters worldwide — it's a fascinating era.
lines.style: Engaged barista nodding along enthusiastically while serving with steady cheerful warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そういえば、エチオピアの山奥には野生のコーヒーの木がまだ残ってるって本当ですか？
lines.en: By the way, is it true wild coffee trees still grow deep in the Ethiopian mountains?
lines.style: Inquisitive student asking a sincere knowledge-seeking question with genuine curiosity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 本当ですよ。広域にわたって自生していて、最近はその保護も大事な話題になってるんです。
lines.en: Yes, really. They grow wild across a wide area, and protecting them has become an important topic recently.
lines.style: Informative barista delivering facts in patient teaching tone with quiet pride.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。僕、毎日飲むので頻度はかなり高いんですけど、ちゃんと知って飲みたいなあ。
lines.en: I see. I drink it every day so my frequency is pretty high — I want to drink it knowing more about it.
lines.style: Reflective student processing new information with self-aware playful seriousness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ふふ、いい心がけですね。昔は石炭ストーブで豆を煎ってた時代もあって、歴史も結構深いんですよ。
lines.en: Haha, that's a nice attitude. There was even an era when people roasted beans on coal stoves — the history runs pretty deep too.
lines.style: Charmed barista chuckling softly before sharing historical anecdote with affectionate expertise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: コーヒーって単なる娯楽じゃなくて、歴史も技術も詰まってるんですね。勉強になります。
lines.en: Coffee isn't just leisure — it's packed with history and technique. I'm really learning a lot.
lines.style: Appreciative student wrapping up with sincere gratitude and thoughtful summarizing reflection.
